//: The Backrooms' money: the currency of the Exchange, its stalls, the diner, the Breakroom and the Level 2 tunnel crews (faction "currency"), so their traders value it at full price and pay with it. Jobs and Breakroom standing pay in it. One token is worth a fifth of a bottle of almond water.
description: A brass washer stamped with five tally marks and a crooked letter E, punched out at the Exchange's counting table.  Nobody down here trusts paper.  Every stall on Level 1 and every tunnel crew on Level 2 takes them; five buy a bottle of almond water.

//: A few loose tally tokens, as a survivor or worker carries them.
